content.comment_body: Hello, is there a way to remove the green text highlighted in the image below? I'm not sure what it's called, and I haven't found any related information so far. Thanks in advance // [user_name]
Consider using the online help feature...
Hello, Navigate to Tool/Options/Preferences and uncheck the corresponding box. This will make the parameters disappear. Hope this solution helps.

analysis.insight_summary: Users had trouble locating a method to hide the green overlay text in the [product_name] software interface. Initial answers stated it was not possible, but someone later explained how to use a settings menu to control the overlay visibility, showing that UI customization is available, although clear documentation or discoverability remains an issue.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to be able to adjust the user interface, such as hiding informational overlays, and seek straightforward instructions for how to do so.
